decisions.reason: As a sensor module that visibly broadened the platform, prior development and strategic fit still favor retention, although after several years disappointing demand is harder to dismiss as merely temporary.
Because it was introduced as the successor to an earlier generation, the firm remains publicly and technically committed to it as part of its core hardware roadmap.
The MQTT proxy supports the software side of the ecosystem and, with relatively low ongoing market exposure costs, management is inclined to continue it rather than reverse course.
This CO2 sensor module still fits the announced expansion of the measurement portfolio, so sunk development effort and platform coherence support keeping it despite some rising risk from product age.

The touch panel accessory is less central to the firm's modular platform than core modules and software, and after years on the market management can more readily justify reallocating resources away from it.
